# Moonbot — documentation on scalping, trading algorithms and strategy parameters (v7.71, FVersion=12)

> The official knowledge base of the Moonbot trading terminal (https://moonbot.pro). It covers scalping and autotrading algorithms, ready-made strategy templates in the `##Begin_Strategy ... ##End_Strategy` format, 484 strategy parameters, and kernel settings exposed through MoonProto.

## Mandatory rules for generating and checking strategies

Before composing or analyzing a strategy, read these three documents:
- [AI guide and default values (AI_GUIDE.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/AI_GUIDE.md): the mandatory structure of the `##Begin_Strategy ... ##End_Strategy` block, dangerous defaults when lines are omitted, and the verification checklist.
- [Strategy type selection guide by task (strategy-selection-guide.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/strategy-selection-guide.md): the table “Trading task → Which SignalType to choose → Meaning · Parameters · Template” and an overview of all 23 `SignalType` values.
- [Common configuration mistakes and traps (silent-killers-and-traps.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/silent-killers-and-traps.md): incompatible parameter combinations across tabs and how to diagnose them.

## Parameter reference by tab (484 parameters, FVersion=12)

For a targeted parameter lookup, load only the thematic section you need instead of the whole base:
- [Alphabetical tabular index of all 484 parameters (index.tsv)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/index.tsv): `ParamName`, `Tab`, `Type`, `Default`, `File`, `ShortMeaning`. Parameter names are case-sensitive (`buyPrice`, not `BuyPrice`).
- [Overview of parameter interaction by trade phase (parameters-by-lifecycle.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/parameters-by-lifecycle.md): the `Requires / Overrides / Disabled by` matrix.
- [01. Coin lists and market selection filters (01-filters-and-coins.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/01-filters-and-coins.md): `CoinsWhiteList`, `DynWL/DynBL`, `Ignore*`, `CustomEMA`, `Volume`, `Delta`, `Price`, `Time`, `Ping`.
- [02. Detect algorithm parameters by strategy type (02-detectors-and-signals.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/02-detectors-and-signals.md): separate sections for `MoonShot`, `MoonHook`, `UseHookStrategy`, `MoonStrike`, `Spread`, `Pumps`, `Drops`, `Walls`, `WallsDetection`, `Activity`, `Volumes`, `Waves`, `Delta`, `Liquidations`, `Combo`, `TopMarket`, `Watcher`.
- [03. Buy conditions and volatility modifiers (03-buy-and-modifiers.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/03-buy-and-modifiers.md): the `Buy` and `Delta Modifiers` tabs (`Add*Delta`, `DetectModifier`, `BuyModifier`, `SellModifier`, `StopLossModifier`).
- [04. Order grids and joining take-profits (04-multiorders-and-scales.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/04-multiorders-and-scales.md): the `MultiOrders` tab (`OrdersCount`, `BuyPriceStep`, `OrderSizeStep`, `JoinSellKey`).
- [05. Selling and take-profit tracking algorithms (05-sell-and-take-profit.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/05-sell-and-take-profit.md): the `Sell` tab (`SellPrice`, `SellByFilters`, `SellByCustomEMA`, `PriceDown`, `SellLevel`, `SellShot`, `SellSpread`).
- [06. Stop-loss cascade, breakeven and trailing (06-stops-and-trailing.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/06-stops-and-trailing.md): the `Stops` tab (`StopLoss`, `SecondStopLoss`, `StopLoss3`, `TrailingPercent`, `UseBV_SV_Stop`).
- [07. Master → Slave triggers and session management (07-triggers-and-sessions.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/07-triggers-and-sessions.md): the `Triggers` (`TriggerKey*`, `TriggerByKey`, `TriggerKeysBL`) and `Session` tabs.
- [08. General settings, Telegram/UDP, interface and migrations (08-ui-system-and-migrations.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/params/08-ui-system-and-migrations.md): the `Main`, `UI`, `Telegram` tabs, the `FVersion` rename history and the `MoonBot.ini` options.

## Kernel settings and MoonProto integration

Global kernel settings are separate from strategy parameters. Start from a received settings snapshot, preserve unedited fields and unknown tails, and check returned values after saving. GUI bounds and units are field-specific; do not infer them from Rust types or SDK defaults.

- [Settings overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/README.md): task-based navigation, units and setting dependencies.
- [SDK field index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/index.tsv): all 539 public fields in 34 SharedConfig structures, their types and exact documentation anchors; includes saved state and reserved fields.
- [Startup and protection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/01-startup-and-protection.md): loss windows, exchange-response time, API errors, working hours and automatic recovery.
- [Signals and alerts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/02-signals-and-alerts.md): Telegram and clipboard parsing, automatic entry switches, sounds and saved filters.
- [Trading and leverage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/03-trading-and-leverage.md): order amounts, entry/exit defaults, pending-order spread, leverage targets and margin policy.
- [Order controls, reports and notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/04-orders-reports-and-notifications.md): clicks, Manual presets, report filters and screenshot destinations.
- [Charts and display](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/05-charts-and-display.md): ticks, order books, volumes, candles, comparison feeds and diagnostic overlays.
- [Drawing tools and news](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/06-drawing-and-news.md): drawing-tool codes, Pencil simulation and news-card settings.
- [Interface and hotkeys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/07-interface-and-hotkeys.md): shortcut encoding, manual presets and market-table layout.
- [Themes and INI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/08-theme-and-ini.md): supported INI keys, colors and whole-section replacement.
- [SharedConfig structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/09-config-structure.md): top-level sections and preservation rules.
- [Choosing the settings API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/reference/settings/10-settings-apis.md): read/edit/send/verify, full versus compact settings, Telegram, WatchDog and client-local options.

## Ready-made strategy templates (`examples/strategies/`)

A strategy block starts with the lines `##Begin_Strategy`, `Active=0` (or `Active=-1`), `FVersion=12`. The terminal pastes several strategies from one text with `Ctrl+V` only if the first line is `##MultiSelection`; otherwise only the first one is pasted.

- [Catalog of all templates (examples/strategies/README.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/README.md)
- [01. CustomEMA filter diagnostics and trade statistics collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/01-ema-rulers-and-data-collector.md)
- [02. Tiered MoonShot strategy pack (two depth tiers)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/02-moonshot-tiered-pack.md)
- [03. Autonomous MoonHook and semi-automatic manual hooks (Manual + MoonHook)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/03-moonhook-and-manual-combo.md)
- [04. Master → Slave links: emulator scout and cascading position add-ons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/04-master-slave-scout-and-ladders.md)
- [05. Global BTC dump shield and delisting protection (MoonNews)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/05-btc-dump-shield-and-delist-guard.md)
- [06. Deep bounce formula and whale monitoring on Hyperliquid (Watcher)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonbot-Tech/MoonDoc/main/examples/strategies/06-deep-bounce-and-hl-watcher.md)
